events.title: Mary, Queen of Scots is defeated at Langside
events.description: Mary's forces were routed near Glasgow by the regent Moray. Three days later she fled to England, where Elizabeth I kept her captive for nineteen years before her execution.
events.html: Mary's forces were routed near Glasgow by the regent Moray. Three days later she fled to England, where Elizabeth I kept her captive for nineteen years before her execution.

events.title: The First Fleet sails from Portsmouth for Australia
events.description: Eleven ships under Captain Arthur Phillip left England carrying some 1,400 people, about half of them convicts. They reached Botany Bay in January 1788 and founded Sydney.
events.html: Eleven ships under Captain Arthur Phillip left England carrying some 1,400 people, about half of them convicts. They reached Botany Bay in January 1788 and founded Sydney.

events.title: US Congress declares war on Mexico
events.description: Congress approved President Polk's request for war after clashes near the Rio Grande. By the 1848 peace, Mexico had ceded California and most of the present American Southwest.
events.html: Congress approved President Polk's request for war after clashes near the Rio Grande. By the 1848 peace, Mexico had ceded California and most of the present American Southwest.

events.title: Churchill offers 'blood, toil, tears and sweat'
events.description: In his first speech to the Commons as Prime Minister, Winston Churchill promised a long struggle and declared his aim to be 'victory at all costs'.
events.html: In his first speech to the Commons as Prime Minister, Winston Churchill promised a long struggle and declared his aim to be 'victory at all costs'.

events.title: Pope John Paul II is shot in St Peter's Square
events.description: Mehmet Ali Ağca shot and seriously wounded the Pope as he greeted crowds in Rome. John Paul II recovered and later visited his attacker in prison to forgive him.
